tools.name: teams_post_adaptive_card
tools.description: Post an Adaptive Card (RCA summary, incident timeline, ranked root causes, draft corrective actions) to a designated Teams channel, with Approve / Edit-Add-Evidence / Reject actions and a tagged responsible engineer.

tools.name: teams_send_direct_message
tools.description: Send a 1:1 escalation direct message to an on-call technician, shift supervisor, or plant manager, e.g. for a Priority 1 breakdown exceeding the configured downtime threshold without an engineer response.

tools.name: teams_get_card_action
tools.description: Retrieve the latest interactive action (Approve, Edit / Add Evidence, Reject, or free-text reply) submitted against a previously posted Adaptive Card, correlated by conversationId/incident_id.

tools.name: teams_schedule_escalation_meeting
tools.description: Auto-schedule a Teams huddle/meeting for a critical breakdown escalation, when configured for Priority 1 incidents exceeding the downtime threshold.
